info1.message: The GauSahar Multipurpose Cooperative was established in Bs. 02/07/2064. It was registered in District Cooperative Office in Pokhara by 4 people in Srijana chowk.The cooperative had been working in the agricultural sector since it was founded but the services diversified from 2073 when the functional committee was changed and headed by present Chairperson Mr. Prem Kumar BC.

info2.message: The Organization initiated its savings and credit services in 2073 with the inauguration of the Head Office situated on Mahendrapool , pokhara. In the following year, 2074, the organization pioneered ATM services, marking a significant milestone as the first ATM service provider in the cooperative history of the western region of Nepal.Moreover, in the same year (BS 2074), the cooperative introduced GauSahar smart banking, QR code payment, and eBanking services.
